summary: America's Car-Mart filed an 8-K disclosing a Third Extension of the Scheduled Termination Date under its Oct. 30, 2025 Silver Point-administered Credit and Guaranty Agreement, now pushed to Sept. 24, 2026, following prior extensions to Sept. 11 and Sept. 18, 2026. Lenders waived anticipated covenant and reporting defaults and granted temporary relief on minimum liquidity and Collateral Coverage Ratio tests. The Company confirms it is running a special-committee-overseen strategic-alternatives review spanning financing, recapitalization, restructuring and M&A, with active third-party and lender talks. Watch for a deal announcement or further extension before Sept. 24, 2026.
